description: What piiflow must and must not report on dotnet/eShop at a pinned commit. Lines are 1-based; a rule with no line matches any line of the file. `categories` must all be among the finding's categories at that location. `findings`, when given, is the exact number of findings of that rule at that location (one per exposure, ADR 0020), and `min_flows` the fewest flows they must cite as evidence.

must.why: The whole CreateOrderRequest (card number, address) is logged, four lines below the comment saying it must not be.
The identified command carrying the order command is logged whole.
MediatR's pipeline behavior logs every command with {@Command}; it is reached only through dispatch.
Logged inside a lambda handed to EF Core's execution strategy.
A Duende IdentityServer event with the user name, written to the log.
The external provider's claims list (subject, name, email) is logged whole: personal data, not data of undetermined category.
Values from the external provider's claims list reach a Duende IdentityServer login event (through the tuple FindUserFromExternalProviderAsync returns).
Search text from the request is embedded by the model.
The chatbot's GetUserInfo tool returns the signed-in user's name, email and address, read off the claims list, to the model.
The checkout form's address and card go to the ordering API, whose base address is configured elsewhere.

must_flows.why: What the user types into the chatbot (@bind) reaches the chat model.
The [SupplyParameterFromForm] checkout model reaches the outbound order request.
The user's subject identifier is logged: a flow, but not a PF001 finding on its own (ADR 0015).

must_not.why: Only the type name and the user id are logged here.
The password goes to ASP.NET Identity's sign-in, which stays inside the system.
The webhook payload carries order and stock events, not personal data.
The route parameter `ItemId` identifies a catalogue item, not a person (ADR 0021).
The query parameters `BrandIds` and `TypeIds` identify brands and item types.
`BrandId` and `ItemTypeId` again, in the MAUI app.
Search text whose category is undetermined: an uncertain finding at info, for review, never a personal-data finding.
